title: Bluesky and Raydata: An Integrated Platform for Adaptive Experiment Orchestration
problem: Current experiment orchestration systems like Bluesky lack generalized support for domain-specific data analysis workflows that can be customized for diverse research communities at synchrotron facilities.
motivation: Synchrotrons are collaborative scientific hubs where enabling adaptive, automated data analysis tailored to specific domains could unlock experimental innovation and maximize the potential of modern light sources.
method: The paper presents an integrated platform combining Bluesky for experiment orchestration with Raydata for data analysis. This integration provides a strategic approach to couple these systems, enabling adaptive, domain-tailored data analysis workflows and supporting customized beamline configurations for specific research needs.
key_novelty: Integration of experiment orchestration with adaptive data analysis workflows to enable domain-specific, automated techniques at synchrotron facilities.
contributions: Integration of Bluesky and Raydata for coupled experiment orchestration and data analysis
Framework for adaptive, domain-specific data analysis workflows at synchrotrons
Support for customized beamline configurations for diverse scientific communities
primary_theme: Synchrotron experiment orchestration and data analysis integration
